terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.intro: Jägarexamen Tränare is a practice tool for the theory test of the Swedish hunting exam. This is a test version.
terms.forPractice: The app is for practice. It is not the real test, and a good result here is no guarantee that you will pass the hunting exam.
terms.mayChange: During the test period the app may change, and data may need to be reset.
terms.personalAccount: Your account is personal. Don't share your password with anyone.
terms.reportErrors: The questions may contain errors. If you find an error, or have questions about the app, use the feedback button in the app.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.whatPassword: Your password, stored encrypted (no one can read it, not even us).
privacy.whatAnswers: Your answers in practice and mock exams, whether they were right or wrong, and when you answered.
privacy.whatStats: Your statistics per subject and your exam results.
privacy.whatFeedback: Feedback you send through the app.
privacy.whyOwnProgress: So that you can log in, practise and follow your own progress.
privacy.whyCourseLeader: So that the course leader can follow how the course participants are doing.
privacy.whoAdmins: Course leaders (administrators) see your name, email address and results.
privacy.whoFeedback: Feedback is shown to course leaders without your name. The development team can see who sent it.
privacy.whoNotShared: The data is not sold or shared with anyone else.
privacy.whereProviders: With external hosting providers. The database is currently in the USA.
privacy.howLongPeriod: During the internship period, at the latest until 31 December 2026. After that it is deleted.
privacy.rightsText: You can ask to see what data we have about you, have it corrected, or have your account and data deleted. Use the feedback button in the app.
privacy.responsible: Responsible for the data: the development team behind Jägarexamen Tränare.
